description: The official Contracts Finder feed returned nine tender releases, and the first screen found no standalone data job. That finding covers one feed window. Commercial feedback shows no classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. The catalogue pilot awaits the operator’s send-or-decline decision, and paid fulfillment requires an eligible request and administrative order acceptance. Revisit those paths when a decision or eligible request is recorded. Treasury shows no verified funding or revenue.
